summary: António Maria da Silva (1872–1950) was a Democratic Party politician and several times President of the Ministry of the Portuguese First Republic. He is in the atlas as the holder of two of those turns at the headship of the government: from 1922 to 1923, and from 1925 until the coup of 28 May 1926.
